title: To Instrument
text: Communicate with VISA resources, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Parity} sets Parity bit type; {Block sample time} sets the time interval between samples, {Resource name} sets the vISA resource name available VISA, {Vendor} sets the instrument manufacturer Read-only: instrument manufacturer, {Model} sets the instrument model Read-only: instrument model, {Serial Number} sets the unique serial number associated with instrument Read-only: instrument serial, {VISA resource type} sets the type of VISA resource to configure TCP/IP, {Board index}, {IP address}, {Port number}, {Device ID} sets the iD of device to connect to positive, {EOI Mode}, {Byte order} sets the sequential order, {Read terminator} sets the terminator character for reading data, {Write terminator} sets the terminator character for writing, {Data bits} sets the number of bits to represent one character, {Stop bits} sets the pattern of bits that indicates the end, {Flow control} sets the mode for managing data transmission rate, {Baud rate} sets the communication speed, {Timeout} sets the allowed time to complete operations, {Instrument identification command} sets the sCPI command to send to your instrument, {Validate and test connection} sets the vISA resource connection verification, {Response} sets the instrument query response Read-only: string, {Initialization commands} sets the sCPI command to send to your instrument, {MATLAB Code} sets the mATLAB ® code to send to your instrument MATLAB, {Instrument error check command} sets the sCPI command to send to your instrument, {Upload initialization commands and check instrument error status} sets the initialization and error check commands upload, {Instrument status} sets the instrument initialization response Read-only: string, {SCPI Command} sets the sCPI command to send to your instrument SCPI, {Binary command}, {Binblock data} sets the binblock command to send to your instrument binblock, {Data type} sets the size and format of each, {Command header} sets the sCPI command header to send with input port data SCPI, {Numeric format} sets the format of numeric data Integer, signed, {Enter numeric format} sets the custom format of numeric, {delimiter} sets the delimiting character, {Determine data size automatically} allows block to automatically detect data, {Data size} sets the number of values read, {Action when error occurs} sets the action to take when instrument errors Stop, {Check instrument error} sets the output error message and {Error check command} sets the sCPI command to send to your instrument. Values come from the instance.
